versions.name: Adrenaline
versions.text: After you play a card, if your hand is empty, draw 7 cards. Can only trigger once each game.

versions.name: Adrenaline
versions.text: Starts with 7 counters. Turn end: If you have 2 or less cards in hand, draw cards until you have 3 cards in hand and spend 1 counter for each card drawn.

versions.name: Adrenaline
versions.text: Starts with 7 counters. Turn end: If you have less than 4 cards in hand, spend a counter to draw a card. Repeat until you have 4 or more cards in hand.

versions.name: Adrenaline
versions.text: Starts with 5 counters. Turn end: If you have less than 4 cards in hand, spend a counter to draw a card. Repeat until you have 4 or more cards in hand.

versions.name: Adrenaline
versions.text: Starts with 6 counters. Turn end: If you have less than 4 cards in hand, spend a counter to draw a card. Repeat until you have 4 or more cards in hand.
